MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper would help me measure small components and check mounting dimensions when working with breadboards, circuit boards, and other hardware.",
    "A practical measuring tool fits the hands-on project needs reflected in my electronics parts and caster purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Printer filament assumes I own a 3D printer and have something to print; neither follows from my electronics purchases.",
    "Different filament colors, finishes, and materials do not make them useful without a printing task, and bulk quantities add no reason to buy.",
    "The nut assortment requires matching thread sizes, while the cutting wheels require a compatible tool and a cutting task. I have not established those needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in building electronics seems to have been stretched into an assumed interest in 3D printing.",
    "Broad connections to workshop projects seem to count more than whether an item supports a specific task I actually have."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My component purchases make checking dimensions a plausible need, which is why the caliper feels more useful than printer supplies.",
    "I choose supplies when they fit a concrete project; compatibility and a clear use matter more than a general connection to making things.",
    "My purchases span several years, so older electronics activity alone does not establish a current need for consumables."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my practical project interests but assumed a printing hobby that my purchases do not establish."
}
